login.welcomeDescription: Your dedicated platform for trading abyssal modules in EVE Online. Import your assets, list them for sale, and manage your module inventory all in one place.

assetImport.title: Easy Asset Import
assetImport.description: Import your modules directly from your EVE Online assets. No need to create contracts manually.

appraisal.title: Module Appraisal
appraisal.description: Get accurate value estimates for your modules using our advanced appraisal system.

collections.title: Module Collections
collections.description: Create and share collections of modules. Perfect for organizing your inventory or showcasing your best finds.

locationTracking.title: Location Tracking
locationTracking.description: Keep track of where your modules are located across New Eden. Never lose track of your assets again.

offers.title: Offer System
offers.description: Negotiate module prices directly through our messaging system. Get notified instantly when you receive offers.

contracts.title: Contract Management
contracts.description: Track and manage your contracts in one place. View contract history and monitor your sales performance.

statistics.title: Detailed Statistics
statistics.description: View comprehensive statistics about your modules, sales, and trading performance.

card.title: Welcome capsuleer!
card.description: Sign in with your EVE Online account to get started
